title: French invasion of Egypt and Syria
summary: The English Wikipedia article "French invasion of Egypt and Syria", at revision 1371824920, opens: "The French invasion of Egypt and Syria (1798–1801) was a military expedition to Ottoman-held Egypt and Syria led by Napoleon Bonaparte during the French Revolutionary Wars. The campaign aimed to undermine British trade routes, expand French influence, and establish a scientific and administrative presence in Egypt. Napoleon also sought to sever Britain's connection to its colonial holdings in India, with the long-term ambition of challenging British dominance in the region." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q253684, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1798–1801 campaign during the War of the Second Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
